                uint32_t scale_view_shapes[3] = {(scale_view_offsets[0] >= ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[0] ? 0u : std::min<uint32_t>(1, ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[0] - scale_view_offsets[0])), (scale_view_offsets[1] >= ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[1] ? 0u : std::min<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(cache_rows), ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[1] - scale_view_offsets[1])), (scale_view_offsets[2] >= ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[2] ? 0u : std::min<uint32_t>(32, ext_scale_snapshots.shapes[2] - scale_view_offsets[2]))};
                Tensor scale_view = ext_scale_snapshots.view(scale_view_shapes, scale_view_offsets);
                uint32_t scale_out_shapes[2] = {static_cast<uint32_t>(cache_rows), 32};
                Tensor scale_out = scale_view.reshape(scale_out_shapes, 2);

                // Task 3: consume_c2a_state
                CoreTaskArgs params_t3;
                params_t3.add_inout(state_out);
                params_t3.add_input(flat_state);
                params_t3.add_inout(latent_out);
                params_t3.add_input(ext_latent);
                params_t3.add_inout(cache_out);
                params_t3.add_inout(scale_out);
                params_t3.add_input(flat_cache);
                params_t3.add_input(flat_scale);
                params_t3.add_scalar(state_rows);
                params_t3.add_scalar(latent_rows);
                params_t3.add_scalar(cache_rows);
                TaskId params_t3_deps[1];
                uint32_t params_t3_deps_count = 0;
                if (published_inline157.is_valid()) params_t3_deps[params_t3_deps_count++] = published_inline157;
                params_t3.set_dependencies(params_t3_deps, params_t3_deps_count);
                TaskOutputTensors task_3_outs = rt_submit_aiv_task(3, params_t3);
                TaskId consumed = task_3_outs.task_id();
                TaskId ready__ssa_v3 = consumed;
                ready__rv_v2 = ready__ssa_v3;
            }
        }
    }
}

}  // extern "C"
